answer: Each identity locks 70 credits for one work slot, sealed by a yarrow stamp. It must close within a delta of 3 epochs; late, copied, or missing work burns the bond, and a shared seal burns both. Open slots pile into a public dune, sampled by auditors. First slot 42, k-th 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring burns when its seal repeats. An honest agent pays 42 once and keeps its full share.
